info.title: Automated Driving Crash Reports
info.subtitle: NHTSA ADS and Level 2 ADAS incidents with report-version history
info.description:
Harmonized NHTSA Standing General Order crash reports involving ADS, Level 2
ADAS, and Other/Unknown systems. The release preserves 12,979 report versions
and provides 11,044 latest-version records through 2026.

Raw counts are not safety rates. Reporting access, completeness, duplication,
exposure, operating domain, and mileage differ across entities. The dataset
therefore does not rank manufacturers or calculate comparative safety scores.

Source: NHTSA Standing General Order on Crash Reporting. U.S. government data.
